<!--
FDIC-BRC / JFQA revision (2026-08-08). Two SVB-confound exhibits.
§1 Placebo: DiD around the March 2023 failures with predetermined 2022Q4
   unrealized securities losses as intensity. Cols 1-3 restrict to banks with
   a zero Day-One adjustment (no CECL news); cols 4-5 full-sample horse race
   of Post-SVB x losses against Post x CECL Adj.
§2 BSR orthogonality: approximate the Huberdeau-Reid-Pennacchi (JFI 2025)
   Balance Sheet Risk composite at 2022Q4 and regress CECL Adj on it.
   BSR_approx = (uninsured deposits + short-term borrowings) /
                (total assets - unrealized securities losses)
   [their formula with FHLB advances = 0 and securities-only unrealized
   losses; their UL also includes estimated unrealized loan losses]
Inputs: panel_smallbank (post-jmcb 20260612 vintage via fallback); raw call
  reports (call_report_data_20260401) for the BSR components.
Output: tbl_svb_placebo, tbl_bsr (latex/tables).
-->

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(here)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
source(here::here("tracks", "fdic-brc-jfqa-aug2026", "code", "_track_common.R"))

save_tables <- TRUE

panel <- readRDS(latest_track_file("panel_smallbank"))
setDT(panel)

dt <- panel[abs(qtrs_since) < 12]
dt[, post := ifelse(qtrs_since > 0, 1, 0)]
dt[, post_svb := as.integer(as.Date(D_DT) >= as.Date("2023-03-31"))]

# Loss-signed exposure: positive = larger unrealized securities loss
dt[, loss_22q4 := -unreal_loss_assets_22q4]
med_loss <- median(unique(dt[!is.na(loss_22q4), .(ID_RSSD, loss_22q4)])$loss_22q4, na.rm = TRUE)
dt[, high_loss := as.integer(loss_22q4 > med_loss)]
dt[, D_DT := as.factor(as.Date(D_DT))]

# Placebo subsample: banks with exactly zero Day-One adjustment
zero_ids <- unique(dt[!is.na(cecl_equity) & cecl_equity == 0, ID_RSSD])
dt_zero <- dt[ID_RSSD %in% zero_ids]

setFixest_fml(
  ..controls = ~ log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1 + int_expense_assets_l1,
  ..fe = ~ ID_RSSD + D_DT
)

dict_r <- c(covariate_labels_dict, "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
            "post_svb" = "Post-SVB",
            "loss_22q4" = "Unrealized Loss (2022Q4)",
            "high_loss" = "High Unrealized Loss",
            "post_svb:loss_22q4" = "Post-SVB x Unrealized Loss",
            "post_svb:high_loss" = "Post-SVB x High Unrealized Loss")
order_tbl <- c("Post-SVB x Unrealized Loss", "Post-SVB x High Unrealized Loss",
               "Post x CECL Adj", "Post x High CECL")

r <- list(
  placebo_cont = feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post_svb:loss_22q4 + ..controls | ..fe,
                       data = dt_zero, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  placebo_bin  = feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post_svb:high_loss + ..controls | ..fe,
                       data = dt_zero, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  placebo_ins  = feols(ins_time_deps_assets ~ post_svb:loss_22q4 + ..controls | ..fe,
                       data = dt_zero, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  horse_cont   = feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post_svb:loss_22q4 + post * cecl_equity +
                         ..controls | ..fe, data = dt, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  horse_bin    = feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post_svb:high_loss + post * high_cecl_equity +
                         ..controls | ..fe, data = dt, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)

cat("\n================ SVB PLACEBO ================\n")
etable(r, dict = dict_r, order = order_tbl)
# Sample split (cols 1-3 zero-CECL, cols 4-5 full) is described in the
# table notes in tables_figures.tex.
export_track_tbl(r, "tbl_svb_placebo", dict_r, order_tbl)

cat("\n================ DIAGNOSTICS ================\n")
cat("Full window rows:", nrow(dt), "| banks:", uniqueN(dt$ID_RSSD), "\n")
cat("Zero-CECL rows:", nrow(dt_zero), "| banks:", uniqueN(dt_zero$ID_RSSD), "\n")
cat("High-loss median split (loss-signed, % assets):", round(med_loss, 3), "\n")
bl <- unique(dt[!is.na(loss_22q4) & !is.na(cecl_equity), .(ID_RSSD, loss_22q4, cecl_equity)])
cat("cor(loss_22q4, cecl_equity):", round(cor(bl$loss_22q4, bl$cecl_equity), 3), "\n")
```

## §2 BSR orthogonality (Huberdeau-Reid-Pennacchi run-risk composite)

```{r}
# Raw call reports: data/raw/call_report_data_20260401_{1,2}.rds (upstream
# FFIEC pull; same files consumed by 01_build_panel_20260612.R).
raw <- readRDS(here::here("data", "raw", "call_report_data_20260401_1.rds")); setDT(raw)
raw2 <- readRDS(here::here("data", "raw", "call_report_data_20260401_2.rds")); setDT(raw2)
raw <- rbind(raw, raw2, fill = TRUE); rm(raw2)
raw[, D_DT := as.Date(D_DT)]
raw <- unique(raw, by = c("ID_RSSD", "D_DT"))

q4 <- raw[D_DT == as.Date("2022-12-31")]
q4[, ul_sec := pmax(0, -((afs_fair_value - afs_amortized_cost) +
                          (htm_fair_value - htm_amortized_cost)))]
q4[, ud := fifelse(is.na(unins_deps_excl_ret), 0, unins_deps_excl_ret) +
          fifelse(is.na(unins_ret_deps), 0, unins_ret_deps)]
q4[, stb := fifelse(is.na(fed_funds_purchased), 0, fed_funds_purchased)]
q4[, bsr := fifelse(total_assets - ul_sec > 0,
                    (ud + stb) / (total_assets - ul_sec), NA_real_)]

treat <- unique(panel[qtrs_since == 0 & !is.na(cecl_equity),
                      .(ID_RSSD, cecl_equity, high_cecl_equity,
                        log_ta_22q4, equity_assets_22q4)])
cs <- merge(treat, q4[, .(ID_RSSD, bsr)], by = "ID_RSSD")
cs <- cs[!is.na(bsr)]

dict_bsr <- c(covariate_labels_dict, "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
              "bsr" = "Balance Sheet Risk (2022Q4)",
              "unreal_loss_assets_22q4" = "Unrealized Sec. Loss/Assets (\\%)",
              "unins_dep_share_22q4" = "Unins. Dep./Deposits (\\%)",
              "brokered_share_22q4" = "Brokered Dep./Deposits (\\%)",
              "log_ta_22q4" = "log(Assets)",
              "equity_assets_22q4" = "Equity/Assets (\\%)",
              "cre_loans_share_22q4" = "CRE/Loans (\\%)")

# Combined SVB-exposure table: cols (1)-(3) replicate
# tbl_svb_exposure_20260807 (robustness_svb_20260807.qmd §2); col (4) adds
# the HRP Balance Sheet Risk composite.
cs_ex <- unique(dt[!is.na(cecl_equity),
                   .(ID_RSSD, cecl_equity, unreal_loss_assets_22q4,
                     unins_dep_share_22q4, brokered_share_22q4, log_ta_22q4,
                     equity_assets_22q4, cre_loans_share_22q4)])
cs_ex <- merge(cs_ex, q4[, .(ID_RSSD, bsr)], by = "ID_RSSD", all.x = TRUE)

r2 <- list(
  feols(cecl_equity ~ unreal_loss_assets_22q4 + log_ta_22q4 + equity_assets_22q4,
        data = cs_ex, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(cecl_equity ~ unins_dep_share_22q4 + log_ta_22q4 + equity_assets_22q4,
        data = cs_ex, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(cecl_equity ~ unreal_loss_assets_22q4 + unins_dep_share_22q4 +
          brokered_share_22q4 + cre_loans_share_22q4 +
          log_ta_22q4 + equity_assets_22q4, data = cs_ex, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(cecl_equity ~ bsr + log_ta_22q4 + equity_assets_22q4,
        data = cs_ex, vcov = "hetero")
)
cat("\n================ §2 SVB EXPOSURE + BSR (combined table) ================\n")
cat("N banks:", nrow(cs_ex), "| corr(BSR, CECL Adj):",
    round(cor(cs_ex$bsr, cs_ex$cecl_equity, use = "complete.obs"), 4), "\n")
etable(r2, dict = dict_bsr)
export_track_tbl(r2, "tbl_svb_exposure_bsr", dict_bsr)
```
